status.description: completed = the deliverable is done and the verification assigned to you has been done; partial = partly done; blocked = questions in decision_requests need the dispatcher's decision before work can go on; failed = not done

summary.description: What was done and the key implementation decisions, briefly

commands_run.description: Build, test and script commands run, and their results

verification.description: How the result was verified; if it wasn't, say so and why

decision_requests.description: Questions the dispatcher must decide before work can go on; an empty array if there are none

open_issues.description: Anything not done, not verified, in doubt, or needing the dispatcher's decision
